notes.title: Update notes for May 1st, 2023
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for downloading Project Dark! We've heard your feedback and are constantly integrating changes to improve our game. Please leave us a review if you're enjoying our unique gameplay!
Updates / Fixes:
Increased the margin of error on Keep Still interactions.
Adjusted the Difficulty on in game Sound Mazes.
Added missing sound in several episodes.
Added Exit option to Main Menu.
